controller: Nominal fixed position PID with filtered derivative and conditional-integration anti-windup
selection_method: Nominal steady velocity gain is identified from equilibrium v=50±0.1 mm/s. For the reduced position plant K/s, choose repeated poles at -8/s: Kp=16/K, Ki=64/K; round to 1 and 4, add Kd=.01 and alpha=.85. The gains are frozen before the fault test; no fault waveform is fitted.
nominal_test: 1 mm position offset at elapsed .03s, otherwise 50mm/s cruise; no external load and beta=1 GPa; identical actual nonlinear pressure ODE
fault_validation: Start global t=.4s in steady 50mm/s cruise at x=1mm. At global t=.5s add 5000N and reduce beta to .5GPa. Validation does not change gains.
interpretation: The approximately -51mm/s initial valley and subsequent modest ringing are computed results of this compact hydraulic configuration, not the illustrative textbook -48mm/s or its prescribed oscillation envelope. No curve or voltage is spliced.
